prompts.prompt: Create one complete RED FORTRESS stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Use the attached official MGO3 screenshot as the visual reference. Preserve its sandstone strata, arid Afghanistan valley, hilltop beige Soviet military base, square watchtower with red flag, canvas shades, sandbags, scattered hardy shrubs and warm dusty sunset palette. Translate the scene into a coherent eye-level lateral fighting arena: a continuous flat sandstone-and-packed-earth foreground lane, the recognizable base in the middle distance, layered cliffs and dry mountains farther away. Match the references rather than adding fantasy architecture. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create one complete GRAY RAMPART stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Use the attached official MGO3 references, prioritizing gray_rampart_02 for the dam architecture. Preserve the pale weathered concrete, broad repeated rounded-rectangle sluice openings, stacked service walkways, metal railings, vertical maintenance ladder and channel behind the foreground walkway. Use the second reference only for the gray service buildings, industrial crates, yellow gantry structures and pale layered cliffs. Keep an uninterrupted horizontal concrete fighting lane at the bottom; retain a legible dam in the middle background. Bright dry daylight, restrained gray and sandy colors. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create one complete AMBER STATION stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Follow the attached official MGO3 refinery screenshots. Preserve the weathered industrial concrete, rusted triangular steel roof trusses, fragmented corrugated-metal canopy with sky openings, tall process columns, broad silver elbow pipes, pale green metal stairs and yellow-black safety rails. Build a coherent lateral refinery yard with a flat continuous concrete fighting lane across the bottom, detailed pipework and platforms behind it, distant refinery structures under the cloudy warm sky. Keep architecture and material palette specific to the references, not a generic futuristic factory. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create one complete BLACK SITE stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Use the attached official MGO3 reference, depicting its later military-base configuration. Preserve the pale corrugated warehouse roofs, cream guard cabin on a metal tower with an exterior staircase and grated platforms, chain-link fences, slender lighting poles, dark green containers, wooden pallets and muted gray-green haze. Recompose as an eye-level lateral military service yard with an uninterrupted flat asphalt fighting lane in front and the guard tower and warehouse row clearly readable behind it. Preserve the references' proportions, era and grounded materials. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create one complete CORAL COMPLEX stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Use the attached official MGO3 Cloaked in Silence screenshots as the architectural reference. Preserve the vivid industrial orange Mother Base platforms, dark slate decks, compact connecting truss bridges, orange pedestal cranes, gray utility blocks, exterior metal stairs, white cargo containers, safety railings and deep teal open ocean. Convert the 3D view into an eye-level lateral combat view from a broad flat deck. A continuous slate deck spans the lower fighting lane; recognizable orange platforms, bridges and cranes extend through the middle distance with open ocean and a level horizon beyond. Keep the MGO3 compact configuration visible. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create one complete RUST PALACE stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Follow the attached official MGO3 screenshots of the ruined Lamar Khaate Palace. Preserve its distinctive pale beige masonry, exposed multi-storey rooms, open cylindrical stair towers with visible spiral stairs, broad rectangular window voids, broken arched passages and bare dark angular roof frames. Place a continuous flat dusty stone combat lane in the foreground with the recognizable palace facade close behind, scattered restrained rubble at the edges and dry sandstone hills in the distance. Use sun-bleached colors and dusty daylight. Do not restore intact roofs or transform the building into a medieval castle. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create one complete AZURE MOUNTAIN stage background for a high-definition 2D side-view fighting game. Use the attached official MGO3 Cloaked in Silence references. Preserve the massive irregular dark rocky outcrop, the ruined low stone village with collapsed timber and corrugated roofs, broken freestanding wall fragments, dry grass, scattered green savanna trees, dusty uneven surrounding terrain and bright blue African sky. Compose a continuous flat packed-earth combat lane across the foreground, readable ruins in the middle distance and the distinctive Cradle of Spirits rock rising behind them. Preserve the scale contrast between small ruined buildings and the great rock; do not invent snowy peaks, temples or a jungle canopy. Output exactly one uninterrupted environment image, landscape 16:9, high-detail painted raster game art with clean readable edges and restrained realistic textures; no characters, no creatures, no HUD, no lettering, no watermark, no panel layout, no collage. Keep the foreground fighter silhouettes readable. This is a base stage image, not animation frames and not a spritesheet.

Create ONE production-ready static raster stage backdrop for the fan-made MGS Codec Simulator CQC game. This is explicitly a reference-based lateral CQC adaptation, not an archival screenshot or a certified exact copy. One continuous environment per image, full-bleed landscape 16:9. Compose as a side-on fighting-game camera, with a clearly readable uninterrupted horizontal walkable strip across the lower 18 percent and the defining environment behind it. Use restrained, detailed game-background rendering, preserving the original Metal Gear Solid 3 PS2/HD game's muted olive/ochre atmosphere and visibly weathered materials; do not use the Delta remake design. No people, soldiers, characters, animals, weapon held in foreground, combat effects, HUD, health bar, radar, reticles, map panels, lettering, logo, watermark, border, collage, or alternate views. Do not treat the adapted foreground lane or any recomposed unseen layout as a canonical original-game map. Depict DOLINOVODNO. Preserve the jungle ravine and rope suspension-bridge identity visible in the references: narrow aged brown plank bridge with thin rope sides, tall pale wooden end posts, steep earth-and-rock ravine walls, dense tall dark trees, mossy trunks and leafy olive canopy, yellow-green hazy light. View the bridge approximately from its side in the midground, stretching horizontally between wooded banks; leave a simple connected dirt-and-grass fighting strip in the foreground as the documented CQC adaptation. The bridge should be the main recognizable landmark, modest and old, not a large modern steel suspension bridge. Maintain the dusky forest mood, no bright tropical flowers or fantasy ruins. Reference screenshots partly obscure the bridge with first-person gun and foliage; use only their visible material and structural vocabulary and omit those overlays.
